rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: incomplete import statement. EngineerHomeV2.js was edited in Iter 220ea·33 to add a new dismissible legacy-import promo tile that renders <Wand2/> and a close <X/> icon, but only the JSX was added — the corresponding `Wand2, X` entries in the `import { ... } from 'lucide-react'` block were never added. When React tries to render the home component these symbols resolve to undefined → ReferenceError → EngineerErrorBoundary catches and displays the fallback card. REPRO: 1) POST /api/auth/login with engineer.smoke@gymaxisai.com/EngTest123!, 2) localStorage.setItem('token', <jwt>), 3) navigate to /svc/engineer, 4) observe 'Something went wrong on this screen' card and console error 'ReferenceError: Wand2 is not defined at EngineerHomeV2'. FIX: append `Wand2, X` to the lucide-react named-imports list at line ~28.
